candidate.description: PROC-201 (Find Email) process documentation evaluated against the executable-process invariant set — 10 layers (L1, L5, L8, L9, L10, L12, L13, L14, L15, L24) from US run-003
candidate.scope: Structural completeness of PROCESS.md, CLAUDE.md, heir.yaml, DATA_FLOW.md against the invariant set discovered by US for the executable-process medium

elements.description: L1 — Process document exists at declared CTB position (factory/outreach/201-email-discovery) with three cluster headers (Identity/Contract/Governance)
elements.format: Binary — document exists with three structural clusters mapped to Thing/Flow/Change

elements.description: L5 — Process identity table: 10 fields (ID, Name, Medium, Business Silo, CTB Position, ORBT, Strikes, Authority, Last Modified, Reference). PROCESS.md Section 1 has 11 fields but is missing Medium, Authority, Last Modified from the standard set
elements.format: Table with 10 named fields, all non-empty

elements.description: L5 — HEIR identity: 8 fields (sovereign_ref, hub_id, ctb_placement, imo_topology, cc_layer, services, secrets_provider, acceptance_criteria). heir.yaml has 8 fields but uses non-standard names (sub_hub, component, process_id, business_silo, parent, created_at) — missing 6 of 8 standard HEIR fields
elements.format: YAML with 8 named fields per HEIR spec

elements.description: L8 — Two-Question Intake: both questions answered ('What triggers this?' and 'How do we get it?') in Section 3
elements.format: Two numbered questions with answers — Bedrock §3

elements.description: L8 — Middle table with 4 rows (Gate A/B/C/D), all 5 columns present (Step, Input, What Happens, Output, Tool Used)
L8 — Output block names downstream consumers: LCS Pipeline, Process 700, Million Verifier (planned), Process 202
L8 — Circle block describes feedback loop: email found → slot updated → LCS pipeline → Mailgun → bounce webhook → re-enter 201
L9 — READ table with 17 rows, each row has source, what-it-provides, join-key columns
L9 — Join chain traces to spine ID (outreach_id) via self-join on slot_workbench
L9 — Forbidden paths section present with 5 entries (gate order violation, inconsistent state, no-name slots, overwrite, Neon direct write)

L10/L19 — Define step: Section 6 has C&V classifications and comparator tables, but NOT in the standard 5-column format (Element, ID, Format, Description, C-or-V). Content exists but structure deviates from invariant set
L10/L20 — Map step: No explicit Source→Target→Transform table. DATA_FLOW.md shows read/write paths but not the formal 3-column mapping table. Missing
elements.format: Table — 3 columns (Source, Target, Transform) per L20 spec

elements.description: L10/L21 — Join step: OSAM section has join chain (outreach_id → slot_workbench) but not in the formal 3-column table (Join Path, Type, Description). Content present, format deviates
elements.format: Table — 3 columns (Join Path, Type, Description) per L21 spec

elements.description: L12 — Section 7 has 8 stop conditions. All 6 canonical conditions present: (1) can't answer intake, (2) OSAM gap, (3) 5 consecutive D1 failures, (4) MV credits < 1000, (5) bounce rate > 5% / CAPTCHA > 10%, (6) Strike 3. Plus 2 domain-specific
elements.format: Table — 2 columns (Condition, Action), >=6 rows from canonical set

elements.description: L13 — Section 9 has 6 numbered smoke test steps, each with expected results. Three Primitives Check present (Thing/Flow/Change)
L14/L22 — Section 10 has Process Metrics table with 11 rows defined before build. Columns: Metric, Unit, Baseline, Target, Tolerance
L14/L23 — Sigma tracking table present with 5 metrics tracked. Structure correct (Metric, Run 1-3, Trend, Action). Values empty (correct for BUILD state, requires 3+ runs)
elements.format: Table — 6 columns, trend values from Bedrock §2

elements.description: L24 — ORBT gate rules define all 4 transitions: BUILD→OPERATE (3 runs + auditor), OPERATE→REPAIR (metric outside tolerance), REPAIR→OPERATE (fix + auditor), Any→T/T (Strike 3). Auditor ≠ builder enforced

L15 — Section 11 declares all 14 required fields (trace_id, run_id, step, target, actual, delta, status, error_code, error_message, tools_used, duration_ms, cost_cents, timestamp, signed_by). Append-only enforced
L9 — WRITE table with 4 rows (person_email, has_email, person_source, readiness_tier). Columns: Table, What It Writes, When
